note: The automated ship checkpoint (qcN.py on the ENCODED MP4) plus the human/visual gates. Implemented in repo/v105/work/qc105.py (Studio 2) and studio1/v11/work/qc11.py (Studio 1).

automated.check: -14 <= integrated LUFS <= -12 and true peak <= -2.5 dBTP, measured on the AAC file
per shot, faces >= 120 px wide: CUT if >8% outside the frame, OFF if centre outside 18-82% of width; fail if > max(1, 10% of the shot's face frames)
face boxes reaching into active text bands; fail above 6 frames; low detections listed for visual check
intended cuts re-detected, near-black frames listed (by-design blackouts must be named)
sample step at every cut and the loop seam vs local median: CHECK if > max(0.08, 12x median)
blurred luma diff between last and first frame (< 12 to pass Studio 2's check; v11 standard aims <= 1)
audio and video lengths within one frame
white-out runs (mean luma >= 200) reported; flashes per second <= 3
tools/sharpness.py: SOFT / ZOOM / LOWBIT per shot (report)

visual_gates: frames from the encoded file around every transition (6 per cut: -8,-4,-1,0,+3,+8)
every set piece frame by frame
pre_build_gate: repo/studio/VOIDFX_STUDIO.md §5a (concept, set pieces, text, graphics, shot strength, written benchmark comparison, Studio 1 rules, density + headspace list, lyric recognition)
